narr: A frontal boundary stalled to the south of the ALY County Warning Area, in tandem with several mid- and upper-level disturbances generated widespread heavy rainfall and scattered thunderstorms across southern Vermont on June 6 and 7. Prolonged, moderate to locally heavy downpours lead to isolated poor drainage flooding in Windham County, with one report of a washout on Westminister W. Road. Over the course of the two days, rainfall totals amounted to two to two and a half inches.
ev: A local CoCoRaHS observer reported washout conditions along Westminster W. Rd.
